author: SONAM TMZ
review_text: I’ve generally had a good experience with the eSewa wallet, but sometimes payments fail. It shows an error, and retrying can deduct money twice. At times, money is deducted but the payment doesn’t go through, and in front of the shopkeeper it looks like I haven’t paid, which feels embarrassing. Because of these repeated issues, I’ve stopped using it for now and will return only after they are fixed.
